components.name: Button
components.summary: Pill and round buttons in four roles: ink primary for navigation, sage accent for the one main action, outline secondary, and round icon buttons.

components.name: FilterChip
components.summary: Selectable chips that build a search: ingredients ("enthält Karotten"), keywords, rating, time, last cooked.

components.name: IngredientRow
components.summary: An ingredient with a tick-off circle and its amount, used in cooking mode, on the recipe screen and (with a supermarket category) in the shopping list.

components.name: RecipeCard
components.summary: A recipe in search results, lists, recommendations and the week planner.

components.name: ServingsPicker
components.summary: The stepper that sets servings before cooking starts.

components.name: StepDots
components.summary: Numbered dots showing progress through a recipe's steps in cooking mode.

components.name: TimerChip
components.summary: A running timer, and the inline highlight that marks a detected duration in step text.
